scope: Static screen based on pad net assignments, not completed routing or measurements
typec_gpio_source: reference/hd3ss3220.pdf, pin functions SDA/OUT1 and SCL/OUT2 (UFP GPIO mode)
present_enable: U14 NOR(OUT1, OUT2) accepts high-current advertisement only
candidate_current_qualifier: Invert OUT1 to accept 1.5 A and 3 A; retain downstream attach/readiness checks; do not enable on default current
limit_scope: U15 excludes always-on loads; changing the CC decoder alone does not enforce the 1.5 A input target
ramp_scope: Capacitance directly assigned to +5V_MAIN on this PCB; excludes regulator startup and tolerance

scenario_sources.dram: experiments/lpddr4-1gb/H9HCNNN8KUMLHR.pdf p.198, IDD4R read pattern, two speed bins evaluated separately. Not measured gateway traffic or boot current.
scenario_sources.emmc: reference/samsung-klm8g1getf-b041.pdf section 9.1 table 32, 8 GB: VCC 50 mA, VCCQ 180 mA. At board nominal rails: 0.489 W; HS400 x8, 100 ms RMS ratings do not establish instantaneous peak.
scenario_sources.lcd: Nominal 10 mA backlight branch only, logic and driver excluded.
scenario_sources.usb: reference/hd3ss3220.pdf active CC and SS mux 0.7 mA typical, 0.9 mA maximum under specified test conditions. Count in remaining AON/system budget, not as entire AON load.
scenario_sources.phy: RTL8211F datasheet section 7 ALDPS: link-down power values are unsuitable for active Gigabit.
scenario_sources.remaining: Shared input allowance for SoC, PHY, PMIC overhead not already modeled, Wi-Fi I/O, display logic, AON and all other unmodeled loads. Base board, no expansion. Coincident literature scenarios; no time-domain or thermal validation.

upstream_guard.qualification: Nominal 1.5 A is not a worst-case ceiling. TI lists 42.2 and 88.7 kohm test points surrounding this resistance; neither establishes a guaranteed trip range for an intermediate value.

two_stage_drop_case.basis: High RON at up to 125 C, imposed currents. Excludes board interconnect, transient and converter dropout.

upstream_guard.monitor_on_current_board: U24.19 IMON has no routed track; use an external VBUS current measurement for first-board characterization.

optional_monitor_study.scope: Candidate lab probe only; gain-only nominal voltage, offset and resistor tolerance excluded. No ADC, pad or component committed to PCB.

main_branch_basis: Main branch only; remaining watts cover RK3562, PHY, all other downstream loads and unmodeled losses. Positive residual does not qualify the design. Negative residual is a conflict within the modeled simultaneous-load scenario. Upstream AON and total port current must be checked independently.

ti_1780_ohm_reference.scope: Published test condition; no external resistor tolerance added. Applying low limit at 4.75 V is a sensitivity case, not a guaranteed spec there.

rilm_limits: Typical U15 equation with assumed +/-7.5 percent and 1 percent resistor tolerance; negative headroom means the limit is above the entire source budget. Lower limit must still support startup. No candidate selected.
wifi_basis: review/wifi-power-check.json: 1 A peak is specified at 3.3 V; applying it at 3.584 V is a scenario only
release_gate: Quantify simultaneous SoC, RAM, PHY, eMMC, LCD and AON input loads, conversion/cable losses and startup transients before enabling 1.5 A in production.
